decisions.reason: The preceding client message explicitly identifies both iOS and Android FAQ content, but the Android Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording FAQ localization through app strings.
Representing FAQ content as localizable app strings does not necessarily change the current iOS download-size optimization requirement or any of its attributes.
The source exchange concerns FAQ localization in iOS and Android, not the separate How-To-Use video content or its delivery behavior.
Localizing FAQ content through app strings does not necessarily alter the Android package-size goal, asset-delivery strategy, or optimization priority.
